infoAttributes.content: Custom attributes will be added to the most relevant HTML node.

look.label: Look
look.description: Sets empty axis, corner, bar and point settings.

fillCard.label: Fill the card
fillCard.description: Reaches the element's edges, past its padding.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: First row: series names. Then label, values.

csvUrl.label: CSV address
csvUrl.description: A file in this site, or a dynamic tag.

loopDate.label: Date from
loopDate.description: Blank: the publish date. Terms and users need one.

versusWord.label: Middle word
versusWord.description: Between two parts, such as VS.

delta.label: Show the change
delta.description: The last row against the one before.

legendDim.label: Off opacity (%)
legendDim.description: Clicking a label switches its series off.

partBorder.label: Row border
partBorder.description: A line under each row until you set this.

belowSeries.label: Below the line
belowSeries.description: The series drawn under the middle line.

axes.label: Axes shown
axes.placeholder: Both, the label axis in Minimal

axisLineColor.label: Axis line colour
axisLineColor.description: The line the labels sit against.

averageLabelColor.label: Label colour
averageLabelColor.description: The line colour, until you set this.

radius.label: Corner radius (px)
radius.description: 6, or round in Minimal and on an arc.

barWidth.label: Width (px)
barWidth.description: At most; bars narrow when they would touch.

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.description: Of the first series drawn, or the stacked totals.

quietColor.label: Quiet colour
quietColor.description: The other bars; the text colour at 60% until set.

markColor.label: Colour
markColor.description: The text colour, until you set this.

projectedFrom.label: From
projectedFrom.description: A label; it and every row after it.

bandColor.label: Colour
bandColor.description: The text colour at 35%, until you set this.

arcWidth.label: Arc width (%)
arcWidth.description: Of the radius, from the outside.

options.guide: A guide line and the values

guideColor.label: Colour
guideColor.description: The axis labels' colour, until you set this.

tableAltBackground.label: Every other row
tableAltBackground.description: Counted from the first row of figures.

tableRowBorder.label: Border
tableRowBorder.description: A line in the table line colour until set.

bfbeHoverOn.label: Responds to
bfbeHoverOn.description: The parent needs Children respond to hover.

bfbeHoverDelay.label: Delay
bfbeHoverDelay.description: Milliseconds, so parts arrive in sequence.

bfbeHoverScope.label: Children respond to hover
bfbeHoverScope.description: Parts inside set to A hovered parent move.

bfbeHsOver.label: Over the first section
bfbeHsOver.description: Only with the header over the first section.

bfbeHsDelay.label: Delay
bfbeHsDelay.description: Milliseconds, scrolling down only, so parts arrive in sequence.
